fact: The December 2025 World Bank support mission found the interoperability work done and to be scaled up with additional entities including the private sector, with attention to full use of the NIU and the biometric database, and a student census granting the NIU linked to birth records planned.
title: Madagascar : Projet de gouvernance digitale et de gestion de l'identité (PRODIGY, P169413), Mission d'appui à la mise en oeuvre, Aide-mémoire
